title: LayoutProfile
description: Role-based layout profile (L0/L1/L2). additionalProperties: false per PF-B3. GC-2026-1111-02: extended from flat typography to a role/domain model; all pre-existing keys preserved, all new keys optional; missing role keys fall back to typography.body_pt / east_asia_font / latin_font (PF-B10). GC-2026-1112-06: added optional authors domain (author / affiliation / attribution / bio structure); absence of authors (draft.yaml, gbt7713-2-2022.yaml) stays non-blocking for legacy profiles. GC-2026-1112-06 follow-up fix: added optional tables.cell_first_line_indent_chars (integer, minimum 0, default 0) so pandoc Compact table-cell / tight-list paragraphs explicitly cancel Normal's inherited first-line indent (表单元格缩进归零); absence in the three profiles (draft/gbt7713/stie) stays valid and defaults to 0.

profile.description: Profile name or ID (structure-identity key; in L2 it is the selection key for the L1 venue profile and must match the registry)

kind.description: Profile kind (structure-identity key; L2 must use kind: paper)

target_venue.description: Target venue identifier (structure-identity key, L0/L1 only; presence in L2 fails build per PF-B3)

page.description: Page geometry and margins (structure-identity key, L0/L1 only)

typography.description: Typographic settings. Base keys (body_pt/line_spacing/east_asia_font/latin_font) are PF-B3 overridable; fonts/sizes/paragraph/heading_numbering are the role table (PF-B10 fallback rules apply).

body_pt.description: Body font size in points; also the fallback for every role size not set explicitly

east_asia_font.description: East Asian (CJK) base font family; fallback for every east-asia role font not set explicitly

latin_font.description: Latin base font family; fallback for every latin role font not set explicitly

first_line_indent_chars.description: Body first-line indent in CJK character widths (e.g., 2 per GB/T 7713.1-2025 section 6.5.2)

fonts.description: Role-scoped font families; keys omitted fall back to east_asia_font / latin_font

sizes.description: Role font-size table in points; keys omitted fall back to body_pt

heading_bold.description: Whether heading roles (Heading1-5, AbstractTitle label) are set bold. GC-2026-1112-01: heiti (黑体) headings are NOT bolded — the face itself carries the emphasis; explicit w:b val=0 cancels inherited bold. Absent = generator default (bold on, pre-GC-2026-1112-01 behaviour)

caption_bold.description: Whether caption roles (Caption/ImageCaption/TableCaption) are set bold. GC-2026-1112-01: heiti captions are not bolded. Absent = generator default (bold on)

abstract_label_alignment.description: Alignment of the abstract/keywords label paragraphs (AbstractTitle style: 摘要/Abstract/关键词/Keywords). GC-2026-1112-01: left-aligned, not centered. Absent = generator default (center)

indent.description: Heading number alignment: flush_left per venue S8 / GB/T 7713.2 section 5.2.2

number_title_gap_chars.description: Gap between number and title in CJK char widths (1 per GB/T 7713.2 section 5.2.2)

text_first.description: Text before figure/table in body (venue S11)

cross_reference_required.description: Every figure/table number must be cited in body (venue S11 / GB/T 7713.2 section 5.2.4)

caption_bilingual.description: Captions are provided as a Chinese/English pair (journal-measured 2026-11-12: 范文图题中英成对). Absent/false = single-language caption; bilingual text itself is a writing-layer concern, the style stays identical.

tables.description: Table caption, body, and rule style

caption_position.description: above per GB/T 7713.2-2022 section 5.5.3 / CY/T 170-2019 section 7.2.1.1

header_fill.description: Header-row cell background fill: a hex colour (e.g. "#E5EBF0") or "none". Absent = none (no w:shd written). Journal-measured 2026-11-12: 范文表头浅灰底 RGB(0.898,0.922,0.941) ≈ #E5EBF0, 黑字.

caption_bilingual.description: Captions are provided as a Chinese/English pair (journal-measured 2026-11-12: 范文表题中英成对). Absent/false = single-language caption; bilingual text itself is a writing-layer concern, the style stays identical.

cell_first_line_indent_chars.description: First-line indent (CJK char widths) of pandoc Compact table-cell / tight-list paragraphs. GC-2026-1112-06 follow-up fix: pandoc's Compact inherits Normal's 2-char body indent via BodyText (Normal carries w:firstLineChars='200'), so table cell text (and tight list items) rendered with a 2-char first-line indent against the template (表内文字顶格). This key makes compaction prescribe the effective indent explicitly on the Compact style, overriding the inherited body indent; default 0 (flush). Absent = 0.

formulas.description: Formula rendering settings (structure-identity key, L0/L1 only)

renderer.description: Formula renderer identifier (e.g., omml for native Word equations)

editable_required.description: Equations must be editable equation objects (OMML), images forbidden (venue S9)

display.description: Display equation alignment (centered per GB/T 7713.2-2022 section 5.7.4)

numbering.description: Equation numbering: right-aligned (1) per GB/T 7713.2-2022 section 5.7.4

symbol_styles.description: Four-class symbol fonts per venue S10 / GB 3100-3102

citation.description: Citation style settings (structure-identity key, L0/L1 only)

entry_order.description: Entry field order; venue S16 places author, year first (differs from GB/T 7714 default order)

standard_edition.description: e.g., GB/T 7714-2015 (as cited by venue) or GB/T 7714-2025 (current)

preferred_recency_years.description: Prefer references published within N years (venue S13: 5)

numeric_superscript.description: In-text numeric citations [N] / [1,3] / [2-5] render as superscript (GC-2026-1112-01; common practice for GB/T 7714 numeric citations, user directive 2026-11-12). Reference-list entries (Bibliography), code, and OMML math are excluded; 4-digit numbers (e.g. access dates [2026-11-11]) and comma-space interval forms ([12, 40]) never match. Absent = no superscripting

in_text_forms.description: In-text citation forms (venue S14); full-width for Chinese, half-width for English

joint_corporate_separator.description: Separator between joint corporate (institutional) authors in Chinese in-text citations, e.g., the 、 in 中共中央、国务院 (venue S14 covers natural-person forms only; project fallback per official-document joint-signature convention and P3/P8 current practice; natural-person double authors keep 和 per S14). GC-2026-1114-02.

fallback_entry_forms.description: Reference-entry templates for the four venue-silent document types: keys law [Z] / regulation [Z] / standard [S] / standard_online [S/OL]; online law/policy text follows venue template ④ [EB/OL] by cross-reference and is NOT registered here (single source of truth). Values are {placeholder} templates forming the machine-checkable binding source (PF-W6). Venue-specified templates (专著[M]/期刊[J]/会议[C]∥/预印本[EB/OL]) are not duplicated here. GC-2026-1114-01.

order.description: List ordering; venue S15: [zh_by_pinyin, en_by_surname] (Chinese first, then English)

header.description: Running head: paper title centered per GB/T 3179-2009 section 9.2

authors.description:
Author / affiliation / attribution / bio structure (GC-2026-1112-06). Structure keys + light format parameters only; full sentence templates are assembled by the generator (tools/metalayout.py, phase 2) from the per-paper metadata. No font-size / font-face keys here (user ruling: no type-size changes this round). Optional: profiles without it (draft.yaml, gbt7713-2-2022.yaml) remain valid.

GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework (P2-3): affiliation_style / affiliation_list_alignment / front_corresponding_line / bio_section.position are DECLARATION-ONLY keys — the generator currently implements the measured 范本 forms (numbered_superscript / center / no front corresponding line / after_references); switching them requires generator development and they are not live switches.

affiliation_style.description: Affiliation reference style. numbered_superscript = superscript unit indices after author names (journal-measured template 2026-11-12; per PF-W12 this measured form takes precedence over venue S2, registered as a deviation in stie.yaml). inline_parenthesized = the written venue S2 form '作者姓名（一级单位全称 二级单位全称，所在市 邮编）', kept as the original wording. 声明键 (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework P2-3): the generator currently implements numbered_superscript; inline_parenthesized requires generator development.

corresponding_mark.description: Superscript mark after the corresponding author's name (venue S18: '*')

corresponding_mark_position.description: Position of the corresponding mark among superscripts. after_numbers = tail of the unit-number list ('1,2,*', journal-measured); after_name = directly after the name.

name_separator_zh.description: Separator between Chinese author names in the byline (journal-measured: full-width comma '，')

name_separator_en.description: Separator between English author names in the byline (journal-measured: ', ')

number_separator.description: Separator between unit numbers inside an author superscript (journal-measured: half-width comma ',')

affiliation_list_alignment.description: Alignment of the affiliation-number list paragraph(s) (journal-measured: center, wraps centered). 声明键 (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework P2-3): the generator currently implements center; switching requires generator development.

front_order.description: Front-page top-to-bottom block order (journal-measured, extract-report section 2 line-by-line record)

front_corresponding_line.description: Whether the front page has a dedicated corresponding-author line. false = none; correspondence info is carried only by the byline superscript '*' plus the end-of-paper '通信作者*' entry (journal-measured + user ruling 2026-11-13). 声明键 (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework P2-3): the generator currently implements false (no front corresponding line); true requires generator development.

funding_positions.description: Where the funding block is rendered. front = first page (after keywords, journal-measured); back = first paragraph of the end-of-paper author-info section. Journal-measured duplication: [front, back].

heading.description: End-of-paper author-info section heading (journal-measured: '作者信息', unnumbered)

position.description: Placement of the author-info section relative to the reference list (journal-measured: after_references). 声明键 (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework P2-3): the generator currently implements after_references; before_references requires generator development.

funding.description: Label of the funding paragraph (journal-measured: '基金项目')

first_author.description: Label of the first-author paragraph (journal-measured: '作者简介')

corresponding.description: Label of the corresponding-author paragraph, mark included (journal-measured: '通信作者*')

other_authors.description: Label of the merged other-authors paragraph (journal-measured: '其他作者')

bio_field_order.description: Field order of the full first-author bio (S17 field list plus '单位' between '职称' and '研究方向', journal-measured). '单位' is not a bio object key; the generator resolves it from affiliation_ids through the affiliations registry.

other_author_reduced_fields.description: Reduced fields for the merged other-authors paragraph (journal-measured: birth year, gender, affiliation, work focus)

corresponding_bio_fields.description: Field order of the corresponding-author simple bio (GC-2026-1112-06 final-review rework P2-4). 范本八字段简式：无籍贯/学位/职称；电子邮箱、电话在通信地址之前；地址与邮编合写「通信地址：<addr>，邮政编码 <pc>」。缺省时生成器回落 CORRESPONDING_BIO_FIELDS（同八字段）。OPTIONAL additive key — profiles without it remain valid.
